blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s membership in the compensation committee of corporations could constitute a possible violation of Article VII, Section 13 of the Constitution, a Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) official testified Monday during the 27th day of her impeachment trial. SEC Company Registration and Monitoring Department Director Gerardo del Rosario was testifying as a prosecution witness before the Senate Impeachment Court. Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian asked Del Rosario whether, based on his experience, Duterte’s membership in the compensation committee of Metro City Chow Food Corporation from 2024 to 2025 could constitute a possible violation of the constitutional […]...
